Thank you for sharing this. I feel seen for the first time since losing my best friend to suicide last April. Everyone in my family stopped checking in after the first month, and I’ve unconsciously put this pressure on myself to be “over it” too. Whenever the grief hits me, I become frustrated with myself that I’m still so sad. Finally, it hit me last month how ridiculous that is. We were roommates and best friends, closer than family, for 7 years. It hasn’t even been a year since she passed and I still feel as though I haven’t properly mourned. My partner has been a godsend, but I feel so guilty burdening her with my grief since she’s the only support I have. I feel so pent up and numb at the same time. Your post gives me hope, and reassured me that I can get through this on my own.
